decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8am to 11pm Monday to Saturday and 8am to 10pm on Sunday and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 6 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided, before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.c) The ducting shall be circular.d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.h) The extract flue shall be painted black and maintained as such for its lifespan.
Condition : 7 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7am-5.30pm Monday to Friday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 8 - A bacterial or enzyme dosing unit shall be fitted on all waste discharge points from kitchen sinks and floor drains prior to discharging to the public sewerage system and shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order.
Condition : 9 - Any back door shall be fitted with a self closer and shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order.

Condition : 10 - Before the use hereby approved begins, a fat trap shall be installed and maintained/renewed for the duration of the use and an agreement shall be in place with a contractor for the off-site disposal of fats, oils and grease, particularly to recycle for the production of bio-diesel. These arrangements shall be permanently operated and retained.

Condition : 11 - The use hereby approved shall not commence until a scheme to minimise the effect of noise on the occupiers of the residential units above No.56 has been approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved scheme shall be implemented as approved and shall be retained, as approved, thereafter.
description: Change of use from A2 to A5 (Hot food take-away) and new shop front.
